info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create External Agency Product Service Agency-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of external agency product services within the banking domain. It allows users to define and upload new product service details for external agencies. Typical consumers include banking staff and system integrators who manage partnerships with external agencies. By using this API, developers can streamline the process of integrating and offering diverse product services to agency partners.

post.summary: Create a new product service agency.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new product service agency in the external agency system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create the agency.
